plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that sometime in the 2020s he travelled to an odd object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland, with a treasure hunter named Dennis Åsberg from a diving group called Ocean X. According to Michels, the weirdest things happen around the object, including electronic equipment failing. He tells it because, if true, the object would be doing something no ordinary rock should do.
